title: Bound expected source cost for independent conditionally exact random archives
statement: In the stated restricted model, condition on K=k and on the histogram A of n=m+k IID P rows. Ordering is uniform independent of numerical P. Universal exactness CONDITIONAL on K gives a Bernstein identity, forcing law(Y|A,K)=Q^m and mismatch>=E TV(A/n,Q). At uniform laws, with Z~Bin(n,1/d), fourth-moment interpolation E|Z-n/d|>=sigma^2/sqrt(1+3sigma^2), sigma^2=n(d-1)/d^2, gives phi(d,n)>=(1-1/d)/(2sqrt(1+3n(d-1)/d^2)). This envelope is convex in n, so Jensen over independent ACTUAL K yields mismatch>=(1-1/d)/(2sqrt(1+3(d-1)(m+E K)/d^2)). A TV+eta guarantee with eta<=1/8 therefore requires m+E K>=(d-1)/(12eta^2)-d^2/[3(d-1)]>=(d-1)/(16eta^2). Unbounded heavy-tailed independent archives cannot evade this cost if exactness holds at EVERY size. This does NOT constrain general adaptive mixed source stopping or kernels exact only AFTER mixing over size; no general minimax lower bound or contradiction to the accepted one-row factory is claimed.

requires: Original actual-row source-only exact-product model, plus THIS restricted theorem: choose a.s. finite K>=0 independently of the ENTIRE P stream, including old rows, possibly using independent bits or Q-only information. Draw and PAY K actual fresh P rows. Require universal law(Y|K=k)=Q^m for EVERY positive-probability k and every fixed P,Q. Unlimited Q calls/computation allowed. The extra conditional-exactness assumption is NOT part of the full minimax problem; actual K calls are charged, not unused random budgets.

assumptions: Complete RESTRICTED expected-cost theorem with P-stream independence of ACTUAL archive size and EXTRA exactness conditional at EACH size. It is NOT an expected lower bound for all admissible batch algorithms, P-dependent stopping, exactness obtained only after mixing over stopping events, or arbitrary joint output corrections. The accepted one-row O(d/eta) factory remains valid outside this representation. Full minimax is OPEN. Prior mathematical operations count once. No Capital scientific execution/audit, new novelty/practical claim, source recovery/ZIP or resource change. All known/unknown holds and native-model unverified status persist.
costs: Old m acquisition/storage and ALL actual K new P rows are paid. The bound uses C=E K; finite C permits arbitrary heavy tails, no deterministic cap or exponential moment. Infinite C already has infinite source cost. Conditioned Bernstein uniqueness gives the empirical TV lower bound, centered fourth-moment interpolation gives an explicit convex lower envelope, and Jensen transfers it to m+E K. It is not legitimate to replace arbitrary adaptive P stopping by independent K or require exactness separately on its stopping events. No new source-agnostic upper algorithm or general expected-query lower bound follows. ROOT’s exact counterexample algebra171/500 is a mathematical check, not a Capital-executed test.
contract.units: Expected ACTUAL new P archive rows, exact conditional entire-product law at each size, same-original-row mean mismatch and total variation.
obstruction: The full expected-query minimax remains OPEN. Construct the conditional critical-batch coupler or prove a genuinely general stronger expected lower bound; the independent/each-size-exact archive obstruction does not settle that question.

review.scope: Complete supplied ROOT restricted-model composition using accepted P1 Bernstein argument and elementary fourth-moment/Jensen bounds. Shared capital once; no general adaptive lower bound or Capital execution/audit.
